from cobol_equiv.runtime import (
    Storage, Group, Num, Alnum, Edited, Filler, move, add, SPACES,
)
from cobol_equiv.runtime.files import LineSequentialReader, LineSequentialWriter


def main(stdin: bytes, input_files: dict[str, bytes]) -> tuple[bytes, dict[str, bytes]]:
    amt = Storage("AMT-REC", [
        Alnum("AM-LABEL", "X(6)"),
        Num("AM-VALUE", "S9(7)V99"),
        Num("AM-DATE", "9(6)"),
        Num("AM-QTY", "S9(4)"),
    ])
    rpt = Storage("RPT-FILE", [Alnum("RPT-REC", "X(80)")])
    ws = Storage("WS", [
        Alnum("WS-EOF", "X", value="N"),
        Num("WS-TOTAL", "S9(9)V99", value=0),
        Num("WS-QTY-TOTAL", "S9(6)", value=0),
        Group("LINE-1", [
            Alnum("L1-LABEL", "X(6)"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L1-A", "ZZZ,ZZ9.99-"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L1-B", "$$$,$$$,$$9.99CR"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L1-C", "***,***,**9.99"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L1-D", "+ZZZ9"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L1-E", "99/99/99"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L1-F", "---,--9"),
        ]),
        Group("LINE-2", [
            Filler("X(7)", value="       "),
            Edited("L2-G", "Z(4)9.999"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L2-H", "999B999"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L2-I", "$ZZ,ZZ9.99DB"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L2-J", "ZZ9.9+"),
            Filler("X", value=SPACES),
            Edited("L2-K", "ZZZZ"),
        ]),
        Group("TOTAL-LINE", [
            Filler("X(7)", value="TOTAL  "),
            Edited("TL-AMOUNT", "$$$$,$$$,$$9.99CR"),
            Filler("X(5)", value=" QTY "),
            Edited("TL-QTY", "---,--9"),
        ]),
    ])

    reader = LineSequentialReader(input_files.get("AMOUNTS.DAT", b""), 25)
    writer = LineSequentialWriter()
    rec = rpt["RPT-REC"]

    def write_from(src):
        move(src, rec)
        writer.write(rec.raw.rstrip(b" "))

    while ws["WS-EOF"].text != "Y":
        r = reader.read(amt.record())
        if r is None:
            move("Y", ws["WS-EOF"])
        else:
            move(amt["AM-LABEL"], ws["L1-LABEL"])
            move(amt["AM-VALUE"], ws["L1-A"], ws["L1-B"], ws["L1-C"],
                 ws["L2-G"], ws["L2-I"], ws["L2-J"])
            move(amt["AM-QTY"], ws["L1-D"], ws["L1-F"], ws["L2-K"])
            move(amt["AM-DATE"], ws["L1-E"], ws["L2-H"])
            write_from(ws["LINE-1"])
            write_from(ws["LINE-2"])
            add(amt["AM-VALUE"], ws["WS-TOTAL"])
            add(amt["AM-QTY"], ws["WS-QTY-TOTAL"])

    move(ws["WS-TOTAL"], ws["TL-AMOUNT"])
    move(ws["WS-QTY-TOTAL"], ws["TL-QTY"])
    write_from(ws["TOTAL-LINE"])

    return b"", {"REPORT.DAT": writer.getvalue()}
